subject.title: fix(agents): defer bundle MCP runtime retirement until leases release

question: Should normal session bundle-MCP runtime retirement wait for active materialization leases, with force disposal reserved for global shutdown?
rationale: The patch is a focused bug fix, but it changes the cleanup invariant from immediate disposal to wait-on-lease retirement, which affects availability and owner semantics beyond what CI can decide.

options.title: Accept lease-draining retirement
options.body: Merge after normal review if maintainers want active approved follow-up materializations to keep the runtime alive until their lease is released.

options.title: Bound the normal drain
options.body: Add a timeout or explicit terminal cancellation path before merge if cleanup must never wait indefinitely on a leaked materialization lease.

options.title: Pause for broader lifecycle design
options.body: Pause this PR if pending approvals should be modeled as lifecycle records rather than using runtime materialization leases as the cleanup boundary.

recommendation.title: Accept lease-draining retirement
recommendation.body: Merge after normal review if maintainers want active approved follow-up materializations to keep the runtime alive until their lease is released.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans bundle-MCP lifecycle, agent runtime cleanup, and availability tradeoffs, and steipete has the broadest recent history across those surfaces.
